episodes.title: That '90s Pilot
episodes.summary: Donna and Eric spend the Fourth of July at his parents' house in Point Place, where their daughter Leia makes an impression on the other teens in town.

episodes.title: Free Leia
episodes.summary: Eager to impress her friends, Leia goes on a quest to find the perfect flick for movie night. Kitty and Red get to know their new neighbor, Sherri.

episodes.title: Lip Smackers
episodes.summary: After Sherri dishes about her date, Kitty steps in to help her break things off with her beau. A never-been-kissed Leia decides it's time to pucker up.

episodes.title: Rave
episodes.summary: Jay and Leia are crushing on each other, but who will make the first move? Meanwhile, Ozzie's plans for the gang to go to a rave in Milwaukee backfire.

episodes.title: Step By Step
episodes.summary: Ozzie's efforts to set up Kitty's new computer put Leia in an awkward position. An ad for a free jacuzzi lands Nate and Jay in hot water.

episodes.title: The Birthday Girl
episodes.summary: Leia forges ahead with her 15th birthday party, inspired by "Beverly Hills, 90210." Red finds himself in a competition to get Leia the perfect gift.

episodes.title: Boyfriend Day One
episodes.summary: Trying to prove to Red he can be responsible, Jay agrees to run an errand that doesn't quite go as planned. Nikki's tutor makes Nate jealous.

episodes.title: Summer Storm
episodes.summary: A rainy day gives Kitty a chance to declutter, but chaos ensues when she clears out the kids' special stash. Leia asks Nikki for relationship advice.

episodes.title: Dirty Double Booker
episodes.summary: With the clock ticking on her summer in Point Place, Leia feels torn about who to spend her time with. Kitty considers starting a new job.

episodes.title: Kids in America
episodes.summary: As Sherri deals with her landlord, Leia's last day in town gets complicated after Jay expresses doubts about a long-distance relationship.

episodes.title: You Oughta Know
episodes.summary: Back in Point Place, Leia dreads having to come clean to Jay and Nikki about what happened last summer. Kitty strongly urges Donna to move back home.

episodes.title: Something to Talk About
episodes.summary: As Leia and Nate go on their apology tour, Nikki ices them out and Jay thinks of ways to get even. Kitty and Red meet their potential new neighbor.

episodes.title: Just a Friend
episodes.summary: Leia snags a job at the mall to spend more time with Gwen. Nikki tortures a heartbroken Nate. Red and Kitty try to break out of their rut.

episodes.title: Hold My Hand
episodes.summary: Gwen worries her hookup is turning into something serious. Jealousy creeps in when an injured Kitty starts to imagine that the neighbors are wooing Red.

episodes.title: What Is Love
episodes.summary: At a field party, Ozzie tries to drink his woes away, Nikki bets Nate she can get more phone numbers and Leia gears up for Jay's big romantic gesture.

episodes.title: I Can See Clearly Now
episodes.summary: To prove to Leia he's changed, Jay tries to make amends with his past. Kitty visits a healer. When the girls attempt to shoplift, Gwen becomes a target.

episodes.title: Baby-Baby-Baby
episodes.summary: When Leia and Jay reveal that they're taking their relationship to the next level, Red lands in the hospital. Nikki takes a test that puts Nate on edge.

episodes.title: Friends in Low Places
episodes.summary: Red and Kitty hit an obstacle on the way to Paris. With the house free, word spreads and the gang must contain a party that brings all sorts of chaos.

episodes.title: All Apologies
episodes.summary: When Kitty and Red come home to a surprise, Nate takes one for the team — with an ulterior motive. Can Leia and Jay repay the favor?

episodes.title: Doll Parts
episodes.summary: Donna's worried about Kitty and Red's side hustle. When Leia's romantic plans hit a snag, Gwen and Nikki suggest she take matters into her own hands.

episodes.title: Achy Breaky Heart
episodes.summary: A heartbroken Nate takes Jay's advice and re-enters the dating scene, but his lively new girlfriend's family ties test their friendship.

episodes.title: Two Princes
episodes.summary: Ozzie tries to find his missed connection from the wrestling convention. Leia intervenes when Nate and Jay's feud goes too far.

episodes.title: Life Is a Highway
episodes.summary: Gwen pulls a rebellious stunt when her truck-driving father comes home. Ozzie and Isaac go on their first date. Nate has a public outburst.

episodes.title: I'll Stand by You
episodes.summary: Kitty asks Leia for help wiggling out of a tough situation. Bob takes a nostalgic trip through the attic. Theo and Nate spar over Nikki.

episodes.title: Are You Gonna Go My Way
episodes.summary: A game-changing announcement excites everyone — except Red. Nate takes Bob to a men's support group led by a blast from the past.

episodes.title: Don't Look Back in Anger
episodes.summary: While Kitty and Donna clash over parenting styles, a defiant Leia joins her friends for an end-of-summer tradition. Nate makes a heartwarming sacrifice.
